sky.qualification: Comet-21p's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Horizons at the shared 3 September 2026 epoch; body attitude is an arbitrary display orientation.
provenance.qualification: Computed Giacobini–Zinner Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose. JPL position at the shared epoch. The nucleus is an ellipsoid at the published effective radius; the attitude is arbitrary and no photographic surface is claimed.
